title: Mortar for AAC masonry.
officialText: Thin-bed mortar for AAC masonry shall comply with Article 2.1C.1 of TMS 602/ACI 530.1/ASCE 6. Mortar used for the leveling courses of AAC masonry shall comply with Article 2.1C.2 of TMS 602/ACI 530.1/ASCE 6.
